executive_summary: Grants for SME-led studies preparing an applicant’s own new production or service facility abroad. The project assesses technical or commercial feasibility, validates investment assumptions and produces an investment-decision report; a necessary small trial production can be included. Funding covers up to 50% of eligible costs, or 70% for qualifying green projects, capped at EUR 100,000; eligible costs must total at least EUR 50,000. A large enterprise can join only where necessary to the SME-led investment project. Applications run from 2 March to 31 December 2026 after a mandatory RVO quick scan; projects last at most two years.
status_rationale: The RVO Investeringsvoorbereidingsprojecten page (Wat is een investeringsvoorbereidingsproject?) and Staatscourant 2026-7891 sections 4.4(c) and 7(3) fund preparation of an applicant’s own foreign production or service facility, not the subsequent investment itself. A grid-equipment supplier’s qualifying facility could later strengthen the delivery capacity on which the 2GW Program depends, an interpretation of the broad industrial scope rather than a grid-specific call objective. Section 4.2 permits a large-company partner only where its own exporting or investing role is necessary to an SME and the emphasis remains on that SME; the reviewed conditions establish no suitable domestic procurement role for TenneT Netherlands. Type 3 category C3.1 captures the conditional supply-chain benefit if a supplier later makes the investment.
